verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents frequency-based alerts by email or webhook, release creation and deploy recording through its CLI, and resolving or unresolving issues. Nothing in the evidence shows it detecting a resolved issue that reappears in a newer release, or alerting on that separately from new issues. Release tracking and generic alerts are adjacent features, not regression alerting.

support.subject: As an SRE, I get alerted when an error that was fixed comes back in a newer release, distinct from ordinary new-issue noise
